brief: A high-performance duplicate file detection system powered by multi-phase DSA algorithms: BFS/DFS Traversal, DJB2 Hash Tables, Bloom Filters, Directory Tries, and Binary Heaps for Top-K space recovery.

concepts.name: Layered Cascade
concepts.idea: Three identical D-shaped files cascading in isometric perspective, revealing redundant duplicate copies behind a preserved original file.
rationale: Unmistakable triple D lettermark standing for Datastructure Duplicate Detection.
File chamfers and folded dog-ear corner convey document storage and file management.
Deep slate and vivid electric blue palette visually highlights the preserved canonical original.

recommendation: Concept B (Layered Cascade) provides the most immediate visual metaphor for duplicate file detection, scaling seamlessly from 16px favicons to high-resolution application headers.
